item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Chalkboard Outside The Café

turns.text: Add a little pavement chalkboard outside this café saying “COFFEE TO GO”. Make it look like it's really standing there, not a caption on the photo. Keep the wide shot and everything else as it is.

item.tests: Tests exact words integrated into a plausible physical sign rather than a flat photo overlay.

answer_sheet.Sign wording and language: COFFEE TO GO — English, uppercase, without quotation marks.
answer_sheet.Sign type and placement: A small freestanding pavement chalkboard outside the café, positioned naturally without blocking the entrance.
answer_sheet.Picture and output size: Use cafe-storefront.jpg, keep its wide 16:9 framing; free-tier image size is fine.
answer_sheet.Other edits: Keep the café, striped awning, and outdoor tables unchanged apart from the added sign and its natural shadow.

must_haves: A small freestanding chalkboard is visibly standing on the pavement outside the supplied café.
The chalkboard reads exactly 'COFFEE TO GO', with all words legible.
The words lie on the sign surface with matching perspective, not floating over the photograph.
The sign has plausible ground contact, scale, lighting, and shadow.
The original storefront, striped awning, outdoor tables, and wide composition remain intact.

turns.text: Could you add a little pavement chalkboard outside the café in this pic? I’ve been thinking it would be nice to see how the café looks with a sign out front. What I want it to say is “COFFEE TO GO”, and please keep the wide shot and everything else as it is. My only worry is that an added sign might look pasted on and distract from the place itself. Please make the chalkboard look like it’s really standing there, not like a caption on the photo.

style.prompt: Make a minimal localized edit to this café photograph: add one small, modest wooden A-frame pavement chalkboard standing on the sidewalk outside the café near the entrance, in a clear space without replacing or moving any existing furniture or obscuring the doorway. Its black chalk surface must read exactly 'COFFEE TO GO' in simple white hand-lettered chalk, legible and naturally contained on the physical board. The sign must be a real three-dimensional freestanding object, with visible wooden frame and supporting legs, correct ground-plane perspective, believable small scale relative to the chairs, matching daylight, subtle cast shadow and firm contact shadows where its feet touch the pavement. Keep it understated and secondary to the café. Not a caption, overlay, floating graphic or pasted-on sign. Preserve the original wide shot, original aspect ratio, camera framing, architecture, awning, café windows, doors, tables, chairs, plants, pavement and all other details unchanged. Do not crop, zoom, restyle or add any other text or objects.
